backup.production_rule: Replaces two functions in place (get_rate_card_v1 adds an upcoming list; open_booking_hold_v1 stamps the version in force on the check-in date). Same signatures and grants; no data changes. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: the_promotion_is_still_on_the_card
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(public.get_rate_card_v1() -> 'promotions') p where p ->> 'name' = 'Anniversary Promotion' and (p ->> 'nightly_rate')::numeric = 1543)

forward_verification.name: the_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = 'fc03264c76741f0abcb107400f7e7e39' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_rate_card_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260926_rate_card_upcoming.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (the two functions as release rate_card_20260926 left them). pricing.ts treats a missing upcoming list as none, so no function redeploy is needed. Before it, end any card version scheduled after today, or it will not be quoted until its day.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions_then_admin
feature_flags.required_state: Apply, then deploy submit-booking, rate-card, messenger-concierge, telegram-cassy from waves 8e58fab or later (quote() reads upcoming), then publish the admin build with Starts on (63c6537). Until the admin is published nobody can schedule a card.
